purpose: Validate a public-only, plate-addressed sparse pixel extraction path and source-level morphology measurement on a deterministic blind sample from the already frozen JPFM-2F-A structural manifest. This is a measurement/transport validation only and does not unlock external-label inference.

forbidden: nuclear calendar or distance to nuclear test

sample_contract.selection: For each of clusters 0..15, select two rows whose anomaly_score is closest to that cluster's median and two rows with the largest anomaly_score, resolving ties lexicographically by src_id. No replacement and no external labels.
sample_contract.role: Transport, recentering and morphology-QA pilot; not an inferential sample of astrophysical classes.

pixel_transport.plate_identity: Explicit plate_id derived from frozen tile_manifest; no coordinate-addressed plate selection is allowed.
pixel_transport.wcs_semantics: Use the full-plate GSSS WCS only to predict a local pixel neighbourhood. Because final S0 sky positions include the public pipeline's per-plate correction and per-tile Gaia refit, the source is re-centered on the photographic image before measuring morphology; the raw predicted pixel is never treated as exact truth.

photographic_measurement_contract.signal_polarity: photographic_signal = median(background_border) - pixel_value, clipped at zero; algebraically equivalent to constant inversion followed by background subtraction
photographic_measurement_contract.background: outer 12-pixel border of the 161x161 sparse stamp; robust sigma = 1.4826*MAD
photographic_measurement_contract.recenter: Gaussian sigma=1 smoothed photographic signal; choose the maximum within +/-12 pixels of the full-plate-WCS prediction
photographic_measurement_contract.local_reference_rule: Find local maxima in the same stamp above 5 robust sigma, exclude the target and edges, require peak amplitude in [0.5,2.0] times target amplitude, retain at most 12 nearest/usable references. fwhm_ratio/profile_diff require at least 3 usable references.
photographic_measurement_contract.interpretive_boundary: Image-local references are not yet Gaia-vetted stellar standards. The pilot validates measurement feasibility; it does not promote fwhm_ratio/profile_diff to final physical PSF evidence.

predeclared_pilot_gates.plate_open_success: 64/64 sampled rows must obtain a plate-addressed sparse stamp or the pilot is FAIL_CLOSED_TRANSPORT.
predeclared_pilot_gates.source_recovery: At least 80% of sampled rows must have peak_snr>=5 and recenter_offset_px<=12.
predeclared_pilot_gates.finite_morphology: At least 95% of recovered rows must have finite FWHM and elongation.
predeclared_pilot_gates.recenter_distribution: Median recenter_offset_px among recovered rows must be <=4 px and p95 <=10 px.
predeclared_pilot_gates.local_psf_reference_coverage: At least 50% of recovered rows must have >=3 usable local reference sources; otherwise normalized-PSF feasibility is NOT_ADMITTED even if raw morphology succeeds.
predeclared_pilot_gates.no_full_array_access: Static source scan must find no primary_hdu.data/hdul[0].data image access.

post_pilot_rule: External temporal/human/environmental labels remain sealed regardless of pilot outcome. A successful pilot authorizes only engineering of a broader/full label-blind pixel-morphology sidecar and a new frozen morphology clustering.
